Official Godot Isometric Game component, MIT. Commit 6ad6167e0577fe3622c18546138f456b107ce93c (tag 4.7-6ad6167). Source: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-demo-projects/tree/6ad6167e0577fe3622c18546138f456b107ce93c/2d/isometric

Retained TileSet is loaded at runtime and duplicated. Its original isometric tile_shape and tile_layout drive every map_to_local/local_to_map operation. New Kenney atlases replace its visual sources; logical tile size becomes 256 by 128. Original goblin SpriteFrames are extracted from the scene for stationary enemies; the movement script, camera and colliders are not attached. Resource paths are rebased in the vendored .tres/.tscn, and external-resource UIDs belonging to the upstream project are removed so the relocated resources resolve by their delivered paths without stale-UID fallback warnings.
